subject: aftd
title: AF.TD.------TH.AF.ALGN.
description: Diagram in PCC-24. (C)AFTD (affinity tendencies) is crossed with TH-AF-ALGN (thrust affinity alignment). The main line bends at (N)PRI-INFO (principle information): AFTD → (N)PRI-INFO → TH-AF-ALGN (the crossing). (R)ATTN (the reality of attraction) branches from (N)PRI-INFO at the bend. AFL (affinity alignment) branches from the PRI-INFO → TH-AF-ALGN stretch, and CULT-INFO-F (culture information focus) branches from AFL. DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) and INDIV-DY-RT (individual dynamic reality) branch from CULT-INFO-F, and the chain continues INDIV-DY-RT → (R)PART (the reality of participation) → COS-P (cosmic particulars).
